rules.description: An operation on the reference estimate has no matching line on the target.
Matched line whose labor or refinish hours differ by more than the threshold.
A replaced exterior panel has no refinish line or refinish hours.
Welded panel replacement without a corrosion protection line.
Refinished fender without a blend on the adjacent door.
Plastic bumper refinish without an adhesion promoter line.
